new_mechanism_assessments.mechanism: Give each current role exactly one incarnation-sensitive local admission slot with IDLE -> PREPARED(operation_id, slot_incarnation, epoch) -> RELEASED; same-role contenders cannot create a second authoritative PREPARED head, response loss reconciles from current slot state, and stale release after delete/recreate is rejected by changed incarnation bytes/current-blob CAS.
new_mechanism_assessments.o_overlap: O materially contains fencing, durable transition state, idempotency and CAS/readback, but no inspected implementation supplies one current incarnation-sensitive authoritative admission slot per Chat role as the finite-inflight theorem.
new_mechanism_assessments.tested_scope: Part43 finite lattice: 1,728 scenarios / 10,368 strategy evaluations. fixed_role_slot_incarnation had 1,728/1,728 finite-bound proofs, zero bound violations, zero duplicate logical admissions and zero stale-release-unsafe cases. Independent downstream rederivation exactly matched worker counts; a live GitHub Contents delete/recreate probe showed content-identical name-only ABA can accept a stale SHA update whereas changing incarnation bytes produced HTTP 409 and preserved the recreated slot. Scope excludes changing membership, noncooperative publishers, complete rewind, arbitrary sinks and deterministic real 429 resume.
new_mechanism_assessments.root_residual_coverage: finite authoritative in-flight count for a fixed finite membership set

new_mechanism_assessments.mechanism: Store membership_epoch + finite ACTIVE role-incarnation set + wide_ticket_state + ticket_transition_id in one current CAS authority. JOIN activates only after slot initialization/readback; LEAVE retires membership; WIDE captures the exact ACTIVE set by CAS to REQUESTED; while REQUESTED membership changes conflict/fail closed, while ordinary local admission only reads the shared ticket then writes its own local slot.
